auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT
    r.XCL_069
FROM
    results AS res
JOIN
    drivers AS d ON res.XCL_075 = d.XCL_034
JOIN
    races AS r ON res.XCL_074 = r.XCL_065
WHERE
    d.XCL_038 = 'Alex'
    AND d.XCL_039 = 'Yoong'
    AND res.XCL_077 < 20
